Global palm oil prices have corrected sharply amid rising inventories in Malaysia, crude oil prices have softened from recent highs, and several FMCG companies have raised product prices to protect their margins.

items.headline: HDFC Bank jumps 18% as Bank Nifty hits a record. Has it recovered its 2026 losses?
items.summary: HDFC Bank shares have climbed 18.0% so far in November, on course for the stock's biggest monthly gain since November 2020, and the rally helped lift Bank Nifty to a record. Yet the stock is still 17.5% below its last close of 2025. The bank's consolidated profit rose YoY in every quarter it reported this year. What fell was the multiple of that profit investors were willing to pay.
